name: Server-Rendered Content
description: Compares the raw HTML the server returns (no JavaScript) with the rendered DOM to see how much of the visible text, the H1 and the title exist before hydration. Most AI crawlers and agents do not execute JavaScript, so client-only content is invisible to them.
inputs: raw HTML of the page via plain GET (status, content-type, body, redirected, truncated)
rendered DOM: document.body text, first <h1>, document.title

scoring.summary: The built HTML in the repo is what a non-JS agent receives, so it is evaluated on its own (no rendered-DOM comparison). Count words in the body (textContent without script, style, noscript, template, svg). Look for an empty SPA mount (#root, #app, #__next, #__nuxt, #___gatsby, #svelte, #q-app, [data-reactroot]; any matching element). Empty mount and < 50 words -> 0. Empty mount and 50-149 words -> 3 (predicted). No empty mount, < 30 words and client scripts -> 3 (inconclusive). Otherwise 6. On a page flagged by one of those rules, -1 if the HTML has no <h1> and -1 if it has no <title> (floor 0).

rules.condition: body textContent without script, style, noscript, template, svg subtrees, split on /\s+/
<script> with no type or type module / text/javascript / application/javascript, having src or inline code
first selector in ['#root', '#app', '#__next', '#__nuxt', '#___gatsby', '#svelte', '#q-app', '[data-reactroot]'] with ANY matching element whose textContent.trim() is empty
no empty app root AND words < 30 AND client scripts present
one of the three rules above fired AND the HTML has no <h1>
one of the three rules above fired AND the HTML <title> is empty or missing

scoring.status_mapping: Engine rule: 5-6 pass, 3-4 warning, 0-2 fail; inconclusive results are always warning.
scoring.inconclusive: A near-empty body that loads scripts (no SPA mount found) scores 3 with inconclusive true: the HTML alone cannot show whether JavaScript adds the content. Verify live with curl -s <url>.

detect.source_procedure: Runs per page on the built HTML in the served root (static HTML, dist/, _site/, public/ after hugo, out/). Parse the HTML, count body words, look for empty SPA mount points and for <h1>/<title>, and score as above. Needs a build for framework sites; Vite SPA output usually has an empty #root/#app and scores 0.
detect.llm_criteria: Decide whether the page's main text, H1 and <title> are emitted in server HTML or only after client JavaScript runs. Estimate the share of final visible words present in server HTML and bucket it: < 25% -> 0, 25-59% -> 3, >= 60% -> 6. Any SPA mount node from the selector list that is empty in server HTML is an automatic 0 (even if other content exists).

parity.note: The extension diffs a live fetch against the live DOM. The plugin only has the built HTML, which is what non-JS agents receive, so it cannot measure how much text client JavaScript adds; it infers JS rendering from empty SPA mounts and near-empty bodies. Middleware, edge rendering, A/B scripts, CMS content, consent walls, bot-specific responses and host behavior (redirects, 404/401, compression) are not visible.

fix_summary: Serve meaningful HTML without JavaScript: use SSR/SSG or prerendering (Astro default output instead of client:only, Next.js server components or getStaticProps instead of useEffect fetching or ssr:false, vite-plugin-ssr/prerender or a static generator for Vite SPAs), and make sure <h1> and <title> are in the server HTML (Next metadata export, Astro/Hugo layouts). These are architectural changes the plugin can outline or partially apply but the user must approve.

divergences.extension: Computes ratio = raw words / rendered-DOM words and buckets it (< 0.25 -> 0, < 0.6 -> 3, else 6).
divergences.plugin: Scores the raw HTML alone: an empty SPA mount with < 50 words -> 0, with 50-149 words -> 3, a near-empty body that loads scripts -> 3 inconclusive, otherwise 6.
divergences.reason: Source-vs-live: the repo has no rendered DOM. The built HTML is what agents receive.

divergences.extension: An empty app root forces 0 even when the rest of the page is fully server-rendered (e.g. an empty widget mount).
divergences.plugin: An empty mount only costs points when the server HTML has little text (< 150 words).
divergences.reason: Server-rendered pages with a small client widget were failed.

divergences.extension: Only the first element per app-root selector is checked.
divergences.reason: A non-empty first [data-reactroot] hid an empty real mount.

divergences.extension: -1 each when the rendered DOM has an H1 / title that the raw HTML lacks.
divergences.plugin: -1 each when the HTML lacks <h1> / <title> on a page already flagged as client-rendered (predicted).
divergences.reason: Source-vs-live: whether JavaScript adds them cannot be seen; a missing H1 on a static page is the headings check's job.

divergences.extension: Unreachable or non-200 fetches score warning 3; non-HTML content types pass; redirected or truncated fails are raised to 3.
divergences.plugin: Not applicable: only .html files in the served root are audited.
